actions.add_comment_to_record_ai.props.r: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to comment on.
actions.add_comment_to_record_ai.props.t: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).

actions.create_base_ai.description: Create a new base in a workspace.
actions.create_base_ai.props.name.descri: The name for the new base.
actions.create_base_ai.props.tables.desc: A JSON array of tables for the new base. Each table is {"name": "...", "fields": [{"name": "Name", "type": "singleLineText"}, ...]}. The first field of each table becomes its primary field.
actions.create_base_ai.props.workspace_i: The workspace ID (e.g. "wspXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to create the base in. Airtable has no list-workspaces API; get it from a base's metadata or the Airtable UI URL.
actions.create_field.description: Add a new field (column) to a table.
actions.create_field.props.base_id.descr: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.create_field.props.name.descript: The name for the new field.
actions.create_field.props.options.descr: Type-specific options as JSON. Required for select fields, e.g. {"choices": [{"name": "Todo"}, {"name": "Done"}]}; for number {"precision": 0}. Omit for simple text fields.
actions.create_field.props.table_id_or_n: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.create_field.props.type.descript: A valid Airtable field type, e.g. "singleLineText", "number", "singleSelect", "multipleSelects", "date", "checkbox", "multipleRecordLinks".
actions.create_record_ai.description: Adds a record to an Airtable table.
actions.create_record_ai.props.base_id.d: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.create_record_ai.props.fields.de: A JSON object mapping field names to values, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}. Use Get Base Schema (Agent) to learn field names and types. Linked-record and multi-select fields take arrays of ids/strings; attachment fields take an array of objects like [{"url": "https://..."}]. Values are sent with typecast enabled so plain strings are coerced where possible.
actions.create_record_ai.props.table_id_: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.create_table_ai.description: Create a new table in an existing base.
actions.create_table_ai.props.base_id.de: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.create_table_ai.props.descriptio: Optional description for the new table.
actions.create_table_ai.props.fields.des: A JSON array of field definitions; the first entry becomes the primary field. Each entry is {"name": "...", "type": "singleLineText", "description"?: "..."}. Select fields need {"type": "singleSelect", "options": {"choices": [{"name": "Todo"}]}}.
actions.create_table_ai.props.name.descr: The name for the new table.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_record_ai.description: Delete a single Airtable record by its ID.
actions.delete_record_ai.props.base_id.d: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.delete_record_ai.props.record_id: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to delete. Resolve it with Search Records (Agent) or List Records (Agent).
actions.delete_record_ai.props.table_id_: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).

actions.delete_records_batch.props.base_: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.delete_records_batch.props.recor: A list of up to 10 record IDs to delete, e.g. ["recAAA", "recBBB"]. Resolve IDs with Search Records (Agent) or List Records (Agent).
actions.delete_records_batch.props.table: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.get_base_schema_ai.description: Get every table and field in a base.
actions.get_base_schema_ai.props.base_id: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.get_current_user.description: Get the connected token identity and its scopes.
actions.get_record.description: Retrieve a single Airtable record by its ID.
actions.get_record.props.base_id.descrip: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.get_record.props.record_id.descr: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with Search Records (Agent) or List Records (Agent).
actions.get_record.props.table_id_or_nam: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.list_bases.description: List all Airtable bases the token can access.
actions.list_record_comments.props.base_: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.list_record_comments.props.offse: Optional pagination offset returned by a previous call to fetch the next page.
actions.list_record_comments.props.page_: Optional number of comments per page (max 100).
actions.list_record_comments.props.recor: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") whose comments to list.
actions.list_record_comments.props.table: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.list_records.description: List or query records in an Airtable table.
actions.list_records.props.base_id.descr: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.list_records.props.fields.descri: Optional list of field names to return; omit to return all fields.
actions.list_records.props.filter_by_for: Optional Airtable formula to filter rows, e.g. {Status}="Done" or AND({Score}>5, FIND("ace", LOWER({Name}))). Field names go in {curly braces}.
actions.list_records.props.max_records.d: Optional maximum total number of records to return; the action paginates across pages up to this number. Omit to return just the first page (with an offset cursor to continue).
actions.list_records.props.page_size.des: Optional number of records per page (1-100, default 100).
actions.list_records.props.sort.descript: Optional JSON array of sort directives, e.g. [{"field": "Name", "direction": "asc"}]. Direction is "asc" or "desc".
actions.list_records.props.table_id_or_n: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.list_records.props.view.descript: Optional view ID or name to restrict and order results to that view.
actions.search_records.description: Find records where a field matches a value.
actions.search_records.props.base_id.des: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
"contains" (default) does a case-sensitive substring match; "exact" requires the whole field to equal the value. Exact compares the field as text, so it also matches number and checkbox fields by their text value.
actions.search_records.props.max_records: Optional maximum number of matching records to return.
actions.search_records.props.search_fiel: The exact name of the field to match against. Resolve names with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.search_records.props.search_valu: The value to look for in the search field.
actions.search_records.props.table_id_or: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.search_records.props.view.descri: Optional view ID or name to restrict the search to.
actions.update_field.props.base_id.descr: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.update_field.props.description.d: Optional new description for the field.
actions.update_field.props.field_id.desc: The field ID (e.g. "fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to update. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.update_field.props.name.descript: Optional new name for the field.
actions.update_field.props.table_id.desc: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") — this endpoint requires the ID, not the name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.update_record_ai.description: Update fields on an existing Airtable record by its ID.
actions.update_record_ai.props.base_id.d: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.update_record_ai.props.fields.de: A JSON object mapping field names to new values, e.g. {"Status": "Done"}. Only the keys you supply are changed; pass null to clear a field. Linked-record and multi-select fields take arrays of ids/strings; attachment fields take an array of objects like [{"url": "https://..."}]. Use Get Base Schema (Agent) to learn field names and types.
actions.update_record_ai.props.record_id: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with Search Records (Agent) or List Records (Agent).
actions.update_record_ai.props.table_id_: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.update_table.props.base_id.descr: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.update_table.props.description.d: Optional new description for the table.
actions.update_table.props.name.descript: Optional new name for the table.
actions.update_table.props.table_id_or_n: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.upload_attachment_ai.description: Upload a file into an attachment field on a record.
actions.upload_attachment_ai.props.attac: The field ID (e.g. "fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") of a multiple-attachments column. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent) (pick a field whose type is multipleAttachments).
actions.upload_attachment_ai.props.base_: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.upload_attachment_ai.props.conte: The MIME type of the file, e.g. 'image/png' or 'application/pdf'.
The file content encoded as a base64 string (no data: prefix).
actions.upload_attachment_ai.props.filen: Optional name for the file as it should appear after upload.
actions.upload_attachment_ai.props.recor: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to attach the file to.
actions.upsert_records.description: Create or update up to 10 records in one batch call.
actions.upsert_records.props.base_id.des: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).
actions.upsert_records.props.fields_to_m: Optional list of field names used as the match key for upsert, e.g. ["Email"]. When set, records matching on these fields are updated, others created. Leave empty for a plain batch update by id.
actions.upsert_records.props.records.des: A JSON array of up to 10 records, each shaped {"fields": {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}}. To update an existing record without merge keys, include its id: {"id": "recXXXX", "fields": {...}}. Use Get Base Schema (Agent) for field names.
actions.upsert_records.props.table_id_or: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.upsert_records.props.typecast.de: When true (default), Airtable coerces string values to the field type and auto-creates select options. Set false for strict typing.
auth.description:
To obtain your personal token, follow these steps:

    1. Log in to your Airtable account.
    2. Visit https://airtable.com/create/tokens/ to create one
    3. Click on "+ Add a base" and select the base you want to use or all bases. To create new bases, also add the workspace under "+ Add a workspace".
    4. Click on "+ Add a scope" and select "data.records:read", "data.records:write", "data.recordComments:read", "data.recordComments:write", "schema.bases:read" and "schema.bases:write" for full functionality.
    5. Click on "Create token" and copy the token.
